Method of Attack: Ransomware that uses Telegram channels as command-and-control servers
Abuses Telegram API to host client-server communications
Creates Telegram bot via Telegram API with token ID
Posts infected computer details and encryption key seed to Telegram channel
Encrypts user files with extensions DOC, DOCX, XLS, XLSX, JPG, JPEG, PNG, DT, DBF, CD, PDF
Keeps log of encrypted files on user's desktop
Downloads ransom note module 'Informer' (Xhelp.exe) from compromised websites
Requests ransom payment via Qiwi and Yandex.Money
Uses Telegram API to communicate and track victims
Impacted Systems: Windows systems (implied by %USERPROFILE% path and file extensions)
Attack Vector: Execution of malicious Delphi binary requiring Internet connection
Indicators of Compromise: Hardcoded Telegram bot token and channel ID
API requests to https://api.telegram.org/bot/GetMe and sendmessage endpoints
Downloaded module named Xhelp.exe from compromised websites
Encrypted files possibly appended with .Xcri extension
